Maitu,

Good morning, meri jaan. Before you read anything else today, I wanted my words to be the first thing waiting for you.

Ten years of knowing you, and I'm still not done falling for you. Your smile is still my favourite thing in the whole world. Your gossips — I could listen to them for hours and never get bored. And that joyful face of yours fixes any day, no matter how it started.

You know what I love the most? When you're with me, you go into a completely different zone. Silly, happy, totally yourself. Honestly, so do I. That little world of ours is my favourite place to be.

I don't want anything big from life. I just want to enjoy every single moment of it with you — the special ones, the silly ones, and the ordinary everyday ones too.

So go have the most beautiful day today. And smile a lot, okay? Somewhere, I'm smiling just thinking about it.

Yours, always —
Kashii
